d:
In a rare moment beyond politics, Rahul Gandhi opened up about his mother, Sonia Gandhi, offering an emotional and deeply personal glimpse into her life. Speaking at the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love in New Delhi, Rahul shared heartfelt reflections that revealed a different side of the Congress leader. His remarks offered an intimate perspective on the mother-son bond and Sonia Gandhi's journey beyond the public and political spotlight. Watch Rahul Gandhi's emotional words about his mother at the memoir launch.
Produced & Edited By Ankit Kumar
